name: Block Account Create / Login by Country – GRC
author: Robert G.

sections.description:
This plugin blocks login and account creation based on the user’s country, determined via IP geolocation.

It applies globally to all users and roles, including WooCommerce customers, and works for:

  • WordPress login
  • WordPress registration
  • WooCommerce login
  • WooCommerce registration

The country where the plugin is first activated is automatically excluded from blocking to prevent lockout.

Features:

  • Blocks login attempts from selected countries (WP + WooCommerce).
  • Blocks account creation / registration from selected countries.
  • Country-based blocking applies to all roles, not just admins.
  • Installer’s country is never blocked (fail-safe).
  • Optional hard deny via 404 response (stealth mode).
  • Settings page with multi-select country list.
  • Dynamic country list fetched from a public API.
  • Lightweight, no database tables, no cron jobs.

Powered by ipinfo.io for IP geolocation.

External Services

This plugin relies on the following external services:

1. ipinfo.io

Purpose:

  • Determines the country of the user’s IP address during login or registration.

Data sent:

  • User IP address, sent at the moment of login or registration.

Provider:

  • Website: https://ipinfo.io
  • Terms: https://ipinfo.io/terms
  • Privacy: https://ipinfo.io/privacy-policy

2. restcountries.com

Purpose:

  • Fetches a list of country codes and names for the settings page.

Data sent:

  • No personal data. Public GET request only.

Provider:

  • Website: https://restcountries.com
  • API Docs: https://restcountries.com/#api-endpoints-v3-all

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/block-account-login-by-country-grc directory, or install it via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings → Block Login by Country – GRC.
  4. Select the countries you want to block.
  5. Save changes.
sections.faq:
What exactly is blocked?

Users from selected countries cannot:

  • Log in
  • Create new accounts (WordPress or WooCommerce)

Which user roles are affected?

All roles. Administrators, customers, subscribers, everyone.

What happens if geolocation fails?

The request is allowed by default to avoid accidental lockouts.

Can I block my own country by mistake?

No. The country detected during plugin activation is always excluded from blocking.

Can I return a 404 instead of an error message?

Yes. The plugin includes a hard 404 deny mode that can be enabled in code for stealth blocking.
sections.changelog:
2.0 – 2026-01-30

  • Reworked logic to block countries instead of allowlisting.
  • Added blocking for WordPress registration.
  • Added blocking for WooCommerce registration.
  • Applied restrictions to all user roles.
  • Centralized GeoIP logic.
  • Optional hard 404 deny mode.
  • Cleaner, safer sanitization and option handling.

1.5 – 2025-06-13

  • Security hardening and sanitization improvements.
  • Installer country fail-safe enforced.

1.4

  • Fail-safe: installer country always allowed.

1.3

  • Dynamic country list via public API.

1.2

  • Added settings page.

1.1

  • Removed hardcoded country restriction.

1.0

  • Initial release.
